text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the overseas GⅠ challenge decided, 
the three of them set off on their 
journey.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, right before the event, Agnes 
Tachyon brings up the risks of this 
challenge. She then questioned the Trainer 
on whether she should truly be allowed to 
run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Weighing her goal of pursuing her "friend" 
against Manhattan Cafe herself, the 
Trainer decided to cancel the overseas 
trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Manhattan Cafe intended to set 
off on her journey alone. But faced with 
the opposition of those who believe in 
her, her legs refused to move...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the overseas expedition was called 
off, and the next target was set for the 
Takarazuka Kinen.
